import html # Predefined HTML structure for blog posts with placeholders BLOG_FORMAT = """

{title}

{body}
""" def format_blog_entry(headline: str, content: str) -> str: """ Sanitize and format a blog post for safe web display. Parameters ---------- headline : str The main heading or subject of the blog post. content : str The complete textual content of the blog post. Returns ------- str A string containing the sanitized and HTML-formatted blog post, ready for secure presentation on the webpage. Raises ------ ValueError If either `headline` or `content` is empty after stripping. """ # Validate inputs if not isinstance(headline, str) or not isinstance(content, str): raise TypeError("Both headline and content must be strings.") # Strip leading/trailing whitespace cleaned_headline = headline.strip() cleaned_content = content.strip() if not cleaned_headline: raise ValueError("Headline cannot be empty.") if not cleaned_content: raise ValueError("Content cannot be empty.") # Escape HTML special characters to prevent XSS escaped_headline = html.escape(cleaned_headline, quote=True) escaped_content = html.escape(cleaned_content, quote=True) # Replace newlines with
for proper HTML formatting formatted_body = escaped_content.replace("\n", "
\n") # Construct final HTML using the template formatted_post = BLOG_FORMAT.format(title=escaped_headline, body=formatted_body) return formatted_post
